meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成可安全跳转的 2D/3D 关键帧动画，包括 GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧、Anime.js、WAAPI、FLIP、路径、遮罩、SVG 变形/绘制、文字轨迹和 3D 深度效果。
howto.when: 当用户需要为 HyperFrames 合成添加关键帧动画，或诊断关键帧问题时触发。不用于场景策略、品牌设计、媒体搜索、字幕或通用视频规划。

say.text: 让这个方块从左边移到右边，用 GSAP 关键帧。
say.note: Claude 会生成 GSAP 时间线代码，包含移动动画。

say.text: 给这个 SVG 路径添加描边生长动画。
检查当前合成的关键帧是否有问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates seek-safe 2D/3D keyframe animations including GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, and 3D depth effects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a HyperFrames composition needs keyframe animations or diagnostics. Not for scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

say_en.text: Move this box from left to right using GSAP keyframes.
say_en.note: Claude generates GSAP timeline code with the motion.

say_en.text: Add a stroke draw animation to this SVG path.
Check the current composition for keyframe issues.
